scanNote:
GRAMMAR 10-BET. Unit 2 — 'can' mashqlari.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 4-mashq (12 surat), 5a (jadval bo'yicha 10 bo'shliq), 5b (10 savol-javob), 6a (8 shaxsiy savol) — jami 40 ta javob.

4-MAShQ SURATLARI: 1 velosiped, 2 rasm chizish, 3 gitara, 4 raqs, 5 rolik, 6 ot, 7 qush (uchish), 8 oshpaz, 9 uchuvchi, 10 gepard (tez yugurish), 11 qo'shiqchi, 12 basketbol. Nomlari kitobda bosilgan.

5a-MAShQ JADVALI (tekshirildi): Jack — futbol, mashina, rasm BOR; raqs va fransuz tili YO'Q. Karen — raqs va rasm BOR; futbol, fransuz tili, mashina YO'Q. Chris — futbol, fransuz tili, mashina BOR; raqs va rasm YO'Q.
  ⚠ 5-bandda IKKI odam ('Jack and Chris') — lekin 'can' o'zgarmaydi, faqat olmosh 'they' bo'ladi.

⚠ 6a-MAShQ — JAVOBLAR NAMUNA: bu savollar O'QUVChINING O'ZI haqida ('Can you swim?'). Bizdagi javoblar — NAMUNA; har kim o'zining haqiqiy javobini beradi. To'g'ri javob yo'q, faqat to'g'ri SHAKL bor: 'Yes, I can' / 'No, I can't'.

pairsWith.noteUz: 'can' mashqlari. Coursebook 15-bet Ex.13 bilan bir xil mavzu, lekin bu yerda 12 ta harakat va jadval bilan chuqurroq mashq qilinadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
Qolip: 'What can he/she/it do?' → 'He/She/It can + FE'L.'

DIQQAT — ba'zi harakatlar 'the' oladi, ba'zilari yo'q:
  • CHOLG'U asboblari 'the' bilan: play THE guitar, play THE violin
  • SPORT turlari 'the' siz: play football, play basketball
Bu qoidani yodlab qo'ying — imtihonlarda tez-tez so'raladi.

'ride' — ustiga minib boshqarish: ride a bicycle, ride a horse
'drive' — ichida o'tirib boshqarish: drive a car
'fly'  — uchirmoq: fly a plane

items.objectEn: a cyclist on a racing bicycle
a person painting at an easel
a man playing an electric guitar
a dancer in a black outfit
a rider on a brown horse
a woman singing into a microphone

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table and fill in can or can't.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang va can yoki can't ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Jadvalda uch odam va besh harakat: ✓ (qila oladi) va ✗ (qila olmaydi).

Har bandda 'but' bor — demak birinchi qism bilan ikkinchisi
QARAMA-QARSHI: biri can, ikkinchisi can't.

DIQQAT: 'can' barcha shaxsda bir xil, shuning uchun ega kim bo'lishidan
qat'i nazar shakl o'zgarmaydi — faqat MA'NOGA qarang.

items.textEn: Karen ___ dance, but she ___ play football.
Chris ___ paint, but he ___ speak French.
Jack ___ drive and paint, but he ___ dance.
Karen ___ speak French, but she ___ paint.
Jack and Chris ___ play football, but they ___ dance.
items.whyUz: Ikkalasi: futbol ✓, raqs ✗. 'can' ko'plikda ham o'zgarmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table again. In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qayta qarang. Juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
Qolip: 'Can + ISM + FE'L?' → 'Yes, he/she can.' yoki 'No, he/she can't.'

Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI:
  'Can Jack dance?' → 'No, he can't.' ('No, he can't dance' ortiqcha)

Bu — OCHIQ savollar, ya'ni javob sizga bog'liq. Ikkala javob ham to'g'ri:
  'Yes, I can.'  yoki  'No, I can't.'

Javobni kengaytirish mumkin (tabiiyroq eshitiladi):
  'Yes, I can. I can swim quite well.'
  'No, I can't, but I want to learn.'

Quyida namuna javoblar berilgan — o'zingiznikini tuzing.

items.answer: Yes, I can. I can swim quite well.
items.question: Can you swim?

items.answer: No, I can't dance very well.
items.question: Can you dance?

items.answer: No, I can't fly a plane.
items.question: Can you fly a plane?

items.answer: Yes, I can ride a bicycle.
items.question: Can you ride a bicycle?

items.answer: No, I can't play the violin.
items.question: Can you play the violin?
items.whyUz: Skripka chala olasizmi? ('the' bilan — cholg'u asbobi)

items.answer: No, I can't ride a horse.
items.question: Can you ride a horse?

exercises.instructionEn: Now write three things that your partner can do and three things your partner can't do.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi sherigingiz qila oladigan uchta va qila olmaydigan uchta ishni yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Uchinchi shaxs haqida yozasiz, lekin 'can' baribir O'ZGARMAYDI:
  'She can swim.' — 'She cans swim' XATO.

Uchta tasdiq va uchta inkor gap yozing. Ularni 'and' bilan
birlashtirsa ham bo'ladi: 'She can swim and dance.'
modelAnswers: My partner can swim very well.
She can speak English quite well.

wordFormation.introUz: Harakat fe'llari va ulardan yasalgan kasb nomlari.

groups.ruleUz: 'the' bor yoki yo'q — cholg'u va sport
groups.explanationUz: ENG KO'P XATO QILINADIGAN QOIDA. Yodlab qo'ying:
O'zbekchada hammasi 'haydamoq' bo'ladi, inglizchada esa uch xil fe'l.

sentencePatterns.introUz: 'can' bilan savol berish va javob berishning barcha shakllari.

patterns.formula: What can + EGA + do? → EGA + can + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: What can he do? — He can ride a bicycle.
patterns.exampleUz: U nima qila oladi? — U velosiped hayday oladi.
patterns.explanationUz: Ochiq savol — 'nima qila oladi?' Javobda aniq harakat aytiladi.

patterns.formula: Can + EGA + FE'L? → Yes, EGA can. / No, EGA can't.
patterns.exampleEn: Can Jack dance? — No, he can't.
patterns.explanationUz: Yopiq savol — ha/yo'q javobi. Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

patterns.formula: EGA + can X, but EGA + can't Y
patterns.exampleEn: Karen can dance, but she can't play football.
patterns.exampleUz: Karen raqsga tusha oladi, lekin futbol o'ynay olmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'but' ikki qarama-qarshi qobiliyatni bog'laydi. Vergul 'but' dan OLDIN.

patterns.exampleEn: Jack and Chris can play football, but they can't dance.
patterns.exampleUz: Jack va Chris futbol o'ynay oladi, lekin raqsga tusha olmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Ega ko'plik bo'lsa ham 'can' O'ZGARMAYDI — bu uning eng katta qulayligi.

patterns.formula: KENGAYTIRILGAN JAVOB: Yes, I can. + qo'shimcha ma'lumot
patterns.exampleEn: Can you swim? — Yes, I can. I can swim quite well.
patterns.exampleUz: Suza olasizmi? — Ha. Ancha yaxshi suzaman.
patterns.explanationUz: Faqat 'Yes, I can' quruq eshitiladi. Qo'shimcha ma'lumot suhbatni davom ettiradi.
